title: Kevin Zingkhai: 404 Error No Love Found!
original_title: Kevin Zingkhai: 404 Error No Love Found!
overview: My special ‘404 Error No Love Found’ was actually inspired from the song ‘No Love’ by Shubh when I heard it for the first time it just made me remember about how quickly I’d fall in love and how devastating that would be towards the end. This special is about multiple instances where I fell in love but did not find love in return hence the name ‘404 Error No Love Found’.  This special is very heart-felt and very personal but one thing I can assure you is the fact that you will laugh really hard and relate to a lot of things.
